heading: Memory ownership
text:
## Memory ownership [IRET.20]

The Rete engine follows libds's single-ownership discipline
(IARC.1.13). Every heap allocation has exactly one owner;
ownership transfer happens only at explicitly-named APIs.

| Object | Owner | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `ds_rete_engine_t` | Caller of `ds_rete_engine_create` | Until `ds_rete_engine_destroy` |
| `ds_rete_schema_t` + slot descriptors | Engine | Engine lifetime; freed on `ds_rete_engine_destroy` |
| Alpha / beta / terminal node graphs | Engine | From the load until `ds_rete_engine_destroy`; there is no reload ([RARC.10.1]) |
| `ds_rete_expr_t` expression trees | Engine | Read-only after the load; freed with node graphs |
| Interned strings | Engine intern table | Structural names, engine lifetime; slot values, as long as the facts holding them ([IDAT.4.7]) |
| `ds_rete_fact_t` | Engine working memory | From `ds_rete_wm_assert` until `ds_rete_wm_retract` |
| `ds_rete_token_t` | Beta node left memory | From join creation until retraction propagation frees depth-first |
| `ds_rete_activation_t` | Agenda | From terminal-node activation until its match ends ([IDAT.6.2.1]) |
